BiblicalUsage: Chol is common, the ordinary and profane set against the holy, and the law draws the line sharply. David asks for bread and is told there is no common bread, only hallowed bread, the priests are charged to put a difference between holy and profane, and Ezekiel says the priests who show no difference have profaned God's holy things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the line between holy and common is God's own line, and it is drawn for our protection, not our punishment. I hold that when the church blurs the line, it loses the very thing that makes it the church.
